mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_ai_task WHERE task_key=#{taskKey} ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ai_task(skill_code,prompt_version, source_id,task_key,task_status,input_snapshot,snapshot_retention_until) VALUES(#{row.skillCode},#{row.promptVersion},#{row.sourceId},#{row.taskKey},#{row.taskStatus}, CAST(#{row.inputSnapshot} AS JSON),#{row.snapshotRetentionUntil})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ai_task SET task_status=#{row.taskStatus},lease_holder=#{row.leaseHolder}, lease_expires_at=#{row.leaseExpiresAt},next_retry_at=#{row.nextRetryAt},retry_count=#{row.retryCount}, input_snapshot=CAST(#{row.inputSnapshot} AS JSON),output_snapshot=CAST(#{row.outputSnapshot} AS JSON), snapshot_retention_until=#{row.snapshotRetentionUntil},error_detail=#{row.errorDetail},completed_at=#{row.completedAt}, updated_at=#{row.updatedAt} WHERE id=#{row.id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_ai_task WHERE record_type='INVOCATION' AND skill_code='feedback_classify' AND task_status IN ('PENDING','RETRY_PENDING') AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ai_task SET task_status='CANCELLED',next_retry_at=NULL,lease_holder=NULL, lease_expires_at=NULL,error_detail='AI_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE',completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id IN #{id} AND record_type='INVOCATION' AND skill_code='feedback_classify' AND task_status IN ('PENDING','RETRY_PENDING','PROCESSING')

UPDATE t_ai_task SET task_status='PROCESSING',lease_holder=#{holder}, lease_generation=lease_generation+1, lease_expires_at=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),INTERVAL 2 MINUTE),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND record_type='INVOCATION' AND skill_code='feedback_classify' AND task_status IN ('PENDING','RETRY_PENDING')

UPDATE t_ai_task SET task_status='CANCELLED',next_retry_at=NULL,lease_holder=NULL, lease_expires_at=NULL,error_code=#{code},error_detail=CONCAT('ai-worker-terminal:',#{code}), completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND record_type='INVOCATION' AND skill_code='feedback_classify' AND task_status='PROCESSING' AND lease_holder=#{holder} AND lease_generation=#{generation}

UPDATE t_ai_task SET retry_count=retry_count+1, task_status=IF(retry_count>=max_retries,'FAILED','RETRY_PENDING'), next_retry_at=IF(retry_count>=max_retries,NULL,DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),INTERVAL POW(2,LEAST(retry_count+1,6)) SECOND)), lease_holder=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,error_code=#{code},error_detail=CONCAT('ai-worker:',#{code}), completed_at=IF(retry_count>=max_retries,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),NULL),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND record_type='INVOCATION' AND skill_code='feedback_classify' AND task_status='PROCESSING' AND lease_holder=#{holder} AND lease_generation=#{generation}

UPDATE t_ai_task SET task_status='COMPLETED',output_snapshot=CAST(#{output} AS JSON), error_detail=#{error},completed_at=NOW(3),lease_holder=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,next_retry_at=NULL,updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND record_type='INVOCATION' AND skill_code='feedback_classify' AND task_status='PROCESSING' AND lease_holder=#{holder} AND lease_generation=#{generation}

UPDATE t_ai_task SET prompt_version_id=#{row.promptVersionId}, skill_version_snapshot=#{row.skillVersion},prompt_sha256_snapshot=#{row.promptSha256}, model_config_snapshot=CAST(#{row.modelConfig} AS JSON),application_version=#{row.applicationVersion}, latency_ms=#{row.latencyMs},input_tokens=#{row.inputTokens},output_tokens=#{row.outputTokens}, estimated_cost_usd=#{row.estimatedCostUsd},provider_request_id=#{row.providerRequestId}, model_name_snapshot=#{row.modelName} WHERE id=#{row.id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ai_task(record_type,skill_code,prompt_version,prompt_version_id,task_status, source_id,input_snapshot,output_snapshot,snapshot_retention_until,completed_at,latency_ms,input_tokens,output_tokens, estimated_cost_usd,provider_request_id,skill_version_snapshot,prompt_sha256_snapshot) VALUES('PROMPT_EVALUATION','feedback_classify',#{row.promptVersion},#{row.promptVersionId},'COMPLETED',#{row.sourceId}, CAST(#{row.inputSnapshot} AS JSON),CAST(#{row.outputSnapshot} AS JSON),DATE_ADD(NOW(),INTERVAL 30 DAY),NOW(3), #{row.latencyMs},#{row.inputTokens},#{row.outputTokens},#{row.estimatedCostUsd},#{row.providerRequestId}, #{row.skillVersion},#{row.promptSha256})

INSERT INTO t_ai_task(record_type,skill_code,prompt_version,prompt_version_id, task_status,input_snapshot,output_snapshot,snapshot_retention_until,completed_at,latency_ms,input_tokens,output_tokens, estimated_cost_usd,provider_request_id,skill_version_snapshot,prompt_sha256_snapshot,error_detail) VALUES('PROMPT_EVALUATION',#{row.skillCode},#{row.promptVersion},#{row.promptVersionId},#{row.taskStatus}, CAST(#{row.inputSnapshot} AS JSON),CAST(#{row.outputSnapshot} AS JSON),DATE_ADD(NOW(),INTERVAL 30 DAY),NOW(3), #{row.latencyMs},#{row.inputTokens},#{row.outputTokens},#{row.estimatedCostUsd},#{row.providerRequestId}, #{row.skillVersion},#{row.promptSha256},#{row.errorDetail})

INSERT IGNORE INTO t_ai_task(record_type,skill_code,task_key,source_id, prompt_version,prompt_version_id,skill_version_snapshot,prompt_sha256_snapshot,model_config_snapshot, application_version,task_status,input_snapshot,output_snapshot,snapshot_retention_until,error_detail,completed_at, latency_ms,input_tokens,output_tokens,estimated_cost_usd,provider_request_id,model_name_snapshot) VALUES('INVOCATION',#{row.skillCode},#{row.taskKey},#{row.sourceId},#{row.promptVersion},#{row.promptVersionId}, #{row.skillVersion},#{row.promptSha256},CAST(#{row.modelConfig} AS JSON),#{row.applicationVersion},#{row.taskStatus}, CAST(#{row.inputSnapshot} AS JSON),CAST(#{row.outputSnapshot} AS JSON),DATE_ADD(NOW(),INTERVAL 90 DAY), #{row.errorDetail},NOW(3),#{row.latencyMs},#{row.inputTokens},#{row.outputTokens},#{row.estimatedCostUsd}, #{row.providerRequestId},#{row.modelName})

INSERT INTO t_ai_task(record_type,skill_code,prompt_version,prompt_version_id, task_status,input_snapshot,output_snapshot,snapshot_retention_until,user_id,completed_at) VALUES('PROMPT_EVALUATION',#{row.skillCode},#{row.promptVersion},#{row.promptVersionId},#{row.taskStatus}, CAST(#{row.inputSnapshot} AS JSON),CAST(#{row.outputSnapshot} AS JSON),DATE_ADD(NOW(),INTERVAL 365 DAY), #{row.actor},NOW(3))
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ai_task SET lifecycle_status=IF(is_current,'PUBLISHED',IF(#{passed},'TESTED','DRAFT')), approval_status=IF(is_current,'APPROVED',IF(#{passed},'PENDING',NULL)), evaluation_summary=CAST(#{summary} AS JSON),updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND record_type='PROMPT_VERSION'
mapper.select: SELECT skill_code,prompt_version,previous_prompt_version_id previous_id FROM t_ai_task WHERE record_type='PROMPT_VERSION' AND is_current=TRUE AND previous_prompt_version_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id

SELECT skill_code,prompt_version,COUNT(*) total, SUM(task_status IN ('FAILED','RETRY_PENDING')) failures FROM t_ai_task WHERE record_type IN ('INVOCATION','ASSISTANT_QUERY') AND created_at>=DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 15 MINUTE) GROUP BY skill_code,prompt_version
SELECT prompt_version FROM t_ai_task WHERE record_type='PROMPT_VERSION' AND skill_code=#{skillCode} AND is_current=TRUE AND lifecycle_status='PUBLISHED' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT task_key FROM t_ai_task WHERE task_key IN #{key}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(input_tokens,0)+COALESCE(output_tokens,0)),0) FROM t_ai_task WHERE record_type IN ('INVOCATION','ASSISTANT_QUERY','PROMPT_EVALUATION') AND created_at>=CURRENT_DATE
